page.overview:
Who is Utroms?

Utroms are a basic enemy in many levels of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus. They appear both on hover discs, and in their exo-suits. One of the main opponents, Slashuur, a Utrom bounty hunter, appears as a reoccurring boss, and later, unlockable character.

A unique shaped alien who possess a higher form of science and civilization. When their ship crashed in Japan a long time ago, they secretly dwelled on Earth by blending in with the humans. 's master, , was a guardian of the Utroms.
